sentences.en: Sami has been doing this job consistently and every day.
sentences.zh: 萨米一直坚持每天做这份工作。

sentences.en: If you're going to be consistent, then be consistently consistent.
sentences.zh: 如果你打算保持一致，那就应该一贯地做到这一点。

sentences.en: However, apart from Buddhists, hardly anyone can consistently follow this principle.
sentences.zh: 然而，除了佛教徒之外，几乎没有人能够始终如一地遵循这一原则。
